verse.verse_1: By the heaven, and At-Tariq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);
verse.verse_2: And what will make you to know what At-Tariq (night-comer) is?
verse.verse_3: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;
verse.verse_4: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels incharge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds, etc.)
verse.verse_5: So let man see from what he is created!
verse.verse_6: He is created from a water gushing forth.
verse.verse_7: Proceeding from between the back-bone and the ribs,
verse.verse_8: Verily, (Allah) is Able to bring him back (to life)!
verse.verse_9: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).
verse.verse_10: Then will (man) have no power, nor any helper.
verse.verse_11: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.
verse.verse_12: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants),
verse.verse_13: Verily! This (the Quran) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict legal laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).
verse.verse_14: And it is not a thing for amusement.
verse.verse_15: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)).
verse.verse_16: And I (too) am planning a plan.
verse.verse_17: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal you gently with them for a while.
